<pre>@Nullable
public&nbsp;<a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-duration" title="class in com.here.time">Duration</a> validityPeriod</pre>
<div class="block"><p>When set, the price is paid for a specific duration.
 <p><strong>Examples</strong>:
 <p>3600 seconds - price for one hour
 <p>28800 seconds - price for eight hours
 <p>86400 seconds - price for one day
 <p><strong>Note:</strong> When the ticket validity period starts depends on the <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-agency" title="class in com.here.sdk.routing"><code>Agency</code></a> providing the service.
